metadata.prompt: Describe this image and judge whether it is physically reasonable.
metadata.reference: Photorealistic outdoor scene of a snowman standing on a grassy lawn under bright afternoon sunlight. The snowman's surface shows visible water trickles running down its sides, and a shallow, irregular puddle has formed at its base. Long, warm shadows cast across the grass, highly detailed, no text, no watermark.
metadata.rationale: Direct sunlight and warm ambient temperatures cause snow to melt into water trickles and puddles at the base.
